inspectionCoverage.visualMethod: Direct view of every hero and declared static preview, including the registered before/after headwear crop. All 192 raw frames inspected through independently verified lossless logical contact sheets; all 16 MP4s independently decoded to their 12 frames and inspected as temporal strips. All 16 actual browser player elements were started, observed in screenshots and checked for continuing loop / final nonlooping end states.

scoreExplanation.shapeVolume: The fitted headband completes the improved rounded chef construction and preserves coherent front/rear/profile volumes; useful rebuilt apron, garment and hair forms remain intact.
scoreExplanation.color: Mateo retains the source tan/light-amber, warm brown, red, ivory and blue identity with clear separation at logical use size.
scoreExplanation.lightingHighlights: Broad soft highlights describe face, hair, hands and garments consistently across rotations. The subdued matte finish differs from target gloss but fits the requested style.
scoreExplanation.materialDetail: Folded headwear with side knot/tails, layered apron straps/pocket and finished garment edges give purposeful detail without clutter.
scoreExplanation.artifactFreeReadability: The prior headwear gaps and broken lower band are resolved in all four facings and across all motion. No material new clipping, seam, halo, dead spot or temporal defect remains.

observations.observation: The red cloth now sits continuously against the head/hair instead of forming a detached arc. S retains a clean red strip below the fringe, N retains an uninterrupted lower red wrap below the crown, and E/W show fitted side/back volume with a readable side knot and two tails. The previous transparent slots and triangular/round bites through the lower band are gone. Small hair tufts touching the upper edge read as intentional layered hair, not holes through the cloth.

The rounded face, swept brown hair, ivory coat, blue apron/straps/pocket, red necktie and dark shoes retain Mateo’s identity and the useful native form improvements from round01. The result reads clearly as a compact chef at logical 192x320 on light, gray and dark backgrounds.

Broad warm soft shading improves the original faceted source while preserving readable cheek/hair/cloth volumes. Both profiles and rear remain finished and coherent. No target halo, dirty transparency edge, black material patch, blown coat highlight or directional ground shadow appears.

All 192 raw frames and all 192 decoded MP4 frames retain the fitted headwear. In actual playback, idle/work/hold remain continuous loops; each load clip finishes once and stops. There is no new headwear detachment, collapsing garment, source-foot slip, prop jump, material shimmer or visible pose pop.

Original source scale, action contacts and serving composition remain. The work knife stays attached to the right hand, and the original packed 2D salmon retains its source composition and visibility. It remains honestly identified as a 2D insert rather than invented modeled sushi.

resolvedBlockers.resolution: Fitted continuous native cloth wrap replaces the loose hoop; intentional hair layering preserves the continuous readable lower band in S/N/E/W and all 192 frames.

remainingDifferences: The headband is wider and more simply rolled/folded than the target, with small hair tufts over its upper rear/profile edge. These are coherent native design choices, with clean continuous cloth below and no detached background slots.
The model uses a simpler matte finish, smaller eye/gloss accents and fewer garment microdetails than the target. These differences remain readable and appropriate at the intended game size.
Target framing, proportions of individual decorations and edge halo are not copied. Registered source framing and gameplay scale are preserved.
The original source salmon remains a packed 2D plane with intentional camera-ray bias and source functional reach beyond the body cell. This preserved composition is accepted.
